 Delta Is Offering NYC Marathon Runners Special Perks at the Airport
 Kait Hanson 2026년 10월 23일 금 오후 5:30 UTC 0 (ANGELA WEISS / Getty Images) The New York City Marathon is about to get a little sweeter for runners, thanks to some special perks from Delta Air Lines.
 Ahead of the November 1 race, Delta is rolling out marathon-themed treats and activities at New York’s John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) and LaGuardia Airport (LGA), giving runners and their supporters a little extra help during race weekend .
 On Oct. 29 and 30, starting at noon and while supplies last, travelers can stop by stations near baggage claim at both airports to pick up marathon essentials. There will also be sign-making stations where friends and family can create cheering signs before heading out to support runners along the course.
 The perks continue after the race. On Nov. 1 and 2, marathon runners departing from JFK or LaGuardia will receive priority boarding through what Delta is calling “Marathoners’ Zone 1.” Gate announcements will also recognize runners for completing the race.
 Advertisement
 With nearly 60,000 runners expected and more than two million spectators anticipated, the airport extras offer a welcome bit of celebration for those making the trip to New York for marathon weekend.
 The event has come a long way since its debut in 1970 , when just 55 runners finished a course made up of loops around Central Park. In 1976, to celebrate the United States bicentennial, the marathon expanded to all five boroughs for the first time, creating the iconic citywide route runners know today.
 This year’s 2026 TCS New York City Marathon marks the 50th anniversary of the iconic five-borough, 26.2-mile course.
